definitions: There is still plenty of time left to do things or for a situation to develop.
It's too early to make a final judgment or decision because many things could still happen.
examples: Don't give up on the project yet, the day is still young.
We've only been here an hour; the day is still young, so let's explore more.
It's only noon, the day is still young, and we have a lot more to accomplish.
synonyms: it's not over till the fat lady sings
